summary: Nissan Auto Receivables 2026-A Owner Trust filed a 424B5 prospectus for a $1,268,450,000 asset-backed securitization of auto loan receivables. The offering includes multiple tranches of notes (Class A-1 through C) with fixed and floating rates, priced at par to a small discount. Proceeds to the depositor are $1,265,839,050.56 after underwriting discounts. Credit enhancement comes from a reserve account, overcollateralization, and subordination. This is a routine ABS shelf takedown, not a special situation. No deal terms apply.
